not_run.reason: Only 6 GB was free after cleaning session-created folders; the orchestrator required about 25 GB before simulator builds, so the simulator proof moves to a freer Mac.

method: gpui-agent recipes only for input. PinCells text inputs are found dynamically with scroll_until (zero scrolls) and used through returned .node references; no simctl input, osascript, CGEvent, or coordinate fallback.
harness: proof/lockpages/run-one.sh generates a temporary NSH proof entry that mounts the real Shell with view=lockdebug because the shipping App entry cannot see BIR_SHELL_START through NSH capabilities. The route, pages, interface stub, theme, and all UI input are the exact PR-head code path.
